jess-support: Hey team — customer acme-corp hitting frequent 502s and huge tail latency on POST /v1/generate. They provided one request id: req_7b2f9a. Window: 2026-11-12T15:02:03Z -> 15:10:00Z. Can someone help with minimal repros (curl + py/js/go) and what else we need from them?

jess-support: Error snippet they pasted:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_7b2f9a
{
  "error": { "message": "upstream timeout", "code": 502 }
}
```

marco-eng: @jess-support can you get the full raw response headers and the SDK request logs (if they used our SDK) including the client-side timing? Also need the exact model name and payload size. If they can run a curl that reproduces the error that helps a lot.

jess-support: Asked customer for raw dump, they said they used our python SDK v1.3.2 in a short loop. They pasted a snippet, but it's noisy. I'll ask them to run a minimal curl and the debug collector.

tina-devex: Minimal SDK snippets — drop-in tests. Share these with the customer and ask them to redact creds.

```
# Python (sync) minimal repro
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
data = {"model": "rwd/gpt4o-small", "input": "hello world", "max_tokens": 16}
r = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers, timeout=20)
print(r.status_code, r.headers.get('X-Request-ID'))
print(r.text)
```

```javascript
// JS minimal repro (node)
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async () => {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwd/gpt4o-small', input: 'hello', max_tokens: 8 })
  });
  console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('x-request-id'));
  console.log(await r.text());
})();
```

```go
// Go minimal repro
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "io/ioutil"
  "os"
)
func main() {
  json := []byte(`{"model":"rwd/gpt4o-small","input":"hi","max_tokens":8}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(json))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err", err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("X-Request-ID"))
  fmt.Println(string(body))
}
```

jess-support: Also added a single-line curl for quick capture: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/gpt4o-small","input":"test","max_tokens":4}'
```

liam-oncall: ops-bot fired an alert around the same window: 15:05 UTC. @marco-eng after we get the exact request id(s) and debug bundle we can correlate with ingress logs and upstream timings. For now, ask them to run our debug collector and include the req id(s).

liam-oncall: Debug collector command to share: 
```
# run from their environment (redwood-cli installed)
redwood-debug collect --request-id req_7b2f9a --since "2026-11-12T14:55:00Z" --output debug-acme-req7b2f9a.tar.gz
```

marco-eng: Good. Also ask for:
- exact SDK version and dependency tree (pip freeze / npm ls / go list)
- whether they are behind a proxy or WAF
- concurrency pattern (single call or loop)
- payload size and any attachments

sara-support: I'll ping the customer with the above checklist + attach the three SDK snippets and curl. I'll also request the debug bundle and tell them to upload to our internal secure bucket link (Don't share S3 creds in channel).

ops-bot: [alert] High 5xx rate for /v1/generate on prod-eu starting 2026-11-12T15:04:50Z (rate: 12/m). See dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/alert-6789

tina-devex: If they can't run collector, ask for:
- client-side logs with timestamps around 15:02-15:10 UTC
- the raw response body for one failing request (copy/paste)
- full request headers including 'User-Agent' and 'Content-Length'

jess-support: Customer provided two more req ids in DM: req_7b2f9a, req_a3f4d2. Asked them to run the python snippet and the debug collector — awaiting upload.

marco-eng: Once we have the bundle, I'll pull ingress trace, LB timings, and pod logs. If we can reproduce with curl, we can rule out client-side race conditions. If we cannot reproduce, next step is packet capture and SYN/TCP timing from their network (ask them to include pcap if they can).

sara-support: Confirmed they will redact sensitive env vars and will send debug-acme-reqs.tar.gz via secure upload later today.

jess-support: Sweet. I'll update ticket with minimal steps and set expectation: 24h triage SLAT. Leaving thread open until bundle received. :thumbsup:

liam-oncall: Thanks everyone — ping me @liam-oncall if we see a spike after bundle analysis.

marco-eng: Quick helpful note for customer: sometimes 502s are caused by payloads that trigger model fallbacks and longer backend work; if they see large input sequences please include a sample.

sara-support: Customer uploaded the bundle at 2026-11-12T16:20Z to our secure bucket. Moving to internal review channel when triage starts.

jess-support: Closing this Slack thread for external coordination — will open internal thread for eng triage. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
